title: The Clay Arena
intro: Torchlight flickers on a sandy floor. Pebble, your clay hound, presses against your leg. Beyond the gate to the north, something very large is breathing.

things.name: antechamber
things.description: A low stone room with sand on the floor. Old weapons hang on the walls, and an open gate leads north into the arena.

room.title: Antechamber
room.sounds: Through the gate: heavy, slow footsteps, and the scrape of clay on stone.

things.name: arena gate
things.description: An iron gate, wide open. Beyond it lies a round pit of sand.

things.name: bronze sword
things.description: A short bronze sword, green with age but still sharp.

things.name: arena
things.description: A round pit of packed sand under a high stone dome. Cracked clay figures line the walls, as if they had been made and then forgotten.

things.name: arena gate
things.description: The way back south, to the antechamber.

things.name: Clay Warden
things.description: A towering figure of fired clay, twice your height, its face a smooth mask with two burning slits for eyes.

things.name: clay maul
things.description: A slab of fired clay on a stone handle.

things.name: lumpy minion
things.description: A squat clay figure, badly shaped, with one arm longer than the other.

things.name: cracked minion
things.description: A thin clay figure, cracked from head to foot. It moves in jerks.

companions.name: Pebble
companions.description: A clay hound the size of a wolf, warm to the touch. It watches you, waiting.

pet.persona: A loyal clay hound that serves its master.

phases.goal: Attack your foe when your foe attacks your master. Attack whoever your master tells you to attack. Stay where you are when your master says stay.

warden.persona: The Clay Warden, an ancient guardian of fired clay. Proud and slow, it never leaves its arena.

phases.goal: Attack whoever attacks you. Attack whoever attacks your servants.

minion.persona: A clay minion, made by the Clay Warden to serve it.

phases.goal: Your master is dead. Run away to save yourself.
Attack whoever attacks your master. Attack whoever attacks you.

then.say: The sand shifts under your feet. The Clay Warden slowly turns its head toward you, and its two minions lift their clubs.
The Clay Warden cracks from head to foot and crumbles into a heap of dust. Its minions shudder.
